scripts.deploy: npx expo export --platform web && node scripts/patch-web.js && npx netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir=dist
scripts.deploy:cf: npx expo export --platform web && node scripts/patch-web.js && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name salli-app --commit-dirty=true
